newsitem.title: POLAND: Sokolow ups stake in Kolo meat firm.
newsitem.headline: Sokolow ups stake in Kolo meat firm.

text.p: Polish meat processing firm Sokolowskie Zaklady Miesne SA (Sokolow) has raised its stake to 50.8 percent from 46.4 percent in the meat processor ZM Kolo, Sokolow said in a statement on Monday.
Sokolow said that by the end of March next year it would complete payment to Kolo of a total of 3.5 million zlotys for a new issue of 350,000 common shares of the C series.
Last June Sokolow and a company controlled by employees of Kolo bought 55 percent of the firm for 7.15 million zlotys, with Sokolow taking 45 percent.
ZM Kolo employs 1,607 and had sales of 180 million zlotys in 1995.
